spec.situation_desc: had a direct debit taken twice

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Priya speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Gareth Ndlovu. You’ve taken my direct debit twice. I’m really unhappy with the bank—this shouldn’t happen.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry, Gareth. I can see two payments to Northstar Energy for £68.40 each came out on 21 October, and your balance is now £214.16. I’m sure we’ll get that second payment refunded for you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Well, I’d expect it back. I only authorised one payment.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. I’ll look into it for you. Before I access anything further, could I take your date of birth and the first line of your address, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s all verified, thank you. I’ll put a note on the account and ask our payments team to check the duplicate debit. I’ll make sure they contact you within eight weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Eight weeks? That’s a long time when it’s your mistake.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand, and I’m sorry this has been frustrating. I’ll take ownership of it: I’ll send the case to our payments team today, and I’ll call you by 4 pm this Friday with an update, even if they haven’t finished their checks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. And you still think the second payment will come back?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes, I expect it will be returned once the team has checked it. To summarise, I’ve noted the duplicate £68.40 payment, I’m sending it to the payments team today, and I’ll call you by 4 pm Friday. They may take up to eight weeks to get back with their final response. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, I understand. I’ll wait for your call Friday.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, Gareth. I’m sorry again for the trouble, and I’ll be in touch Friday.
